scope: One thin adapter for new final.pt models, reusing existing numerical assays. No new training, model outcomes, long analysis, cloud launch or claim of ring detection accompanies this plan.
recommendation: Separate native useful-memory measurements, conditional closed-state structure, constant-input recovery, acute predictive-cue repair, and navigation effects. Reuse the numerical core; do not run old task-specific command-line wrappers unchanged.

native_trace_adapter.checkpoint_contract: Require final.pt with frames exactly1000000000, matching config/protocol/source hashes and all16 prescribed model identities. Old completed/extra_frames checks belong to other studies and must be replaced.
native_trace_adapter.collection: Use genuine policy rollouts with the new MemoryClock and whole RGB/current-code gate. For comparable challenge data, apply test gap60 to both native-trained and blackout-trained models. Preserve every model and first-discovery failure. Select a bounded number of chronological, physically eligible windows using rules fixed before neural outcomes.
record: raw current and ordinary-replacement code for later cue interventions
position, body heading, last travel direction, velocity and motor vf/vs/vr
hit/done/wall events and pre-teleport physical state
room/goal context, action uniforms and RNG/snapshot state for behavioral forks
native_trace_adapter.timing: State-before precedes the current recurrent observation. State-after follows that observation but precedes the physical action. Retain this distinction for angle labels, pulses and behavior; never process a saved first-action observation twice.
native_trace_adapter.replay_check: Replay saved actual inputs from each saved incoming h/c and compare outgoing state/logits with the native collector before analysis.

native_information_and_occupancy.readout_api: scripts/lstm_ring_probe.py:fit_decoder, decode (fixed ridge and GroupKFold grouped by episode)
native_information_and_occupancy.rule: Fit on separate episodes and keep the trained readout fixed during blackout retention tests. Preserve label-shuffle controls and native-trained controls. Decodability is information evidence, not attraction.
native_information_and_occupancy.occupancy: Do not connect angle-sorted pooled states or angle-conditioned means and call the resulting polygon a ring. Position, goal, room and history can move independently. A controlled conditional family must be checked against held-out native states under compatible physical/context conditions. If native support is absent, report reachable conditional dynamics rather than a ring used in ordinary navigation.
native_information_and_occupancy.conditional_family_template: scripts/lstm_travel_memory_probe.py:prepare_travel_family gives15 visible observations and14 physically coherent forward updates ending at one shared position with fixed saved goal and varied real travel direction. Reuse only this explicitly labeled controlled visible elicitation if a bounded conditional family is needed. Its ordinary-current release, brake and turning delay are not part of the new task and must not be carried over as native behavior.
native_information_and_occupancy.family_limit: A single fixed-goal forward family aligns body heading, travel direction and egocentric goal bearing; it cannot identify the coding frame by itself. Use the already specified different native contexts and held-out readouts rather than inventing a favorable angular variable.

closed_structure_and_recovery.constant_input: Construct one complete input from the actual black-RGB CNN embedding, ALL512 current-code zeros, one fixed native saved-goal vector, a fixed truthful reference previous-action label and fixed reward. Hold this complete input constant over time and identical across compared phases/perturbations. A shared time-varying action sequence is a driven assay, not autonomous dynamics.
closed_structure_and_recovery.measurements: Keep full-state radius/coverage/closure, departure from the fixed reference curve, phase drift and tangent retention. Measure perturbed distance to the time-matched evolving curve to avoid confusing induced phase shift with failed transverse recovery. Test targeted radial kicks plus predefined random normal directions; radial recovery alone does not establish contraction of all511 transverse directions.
closed_structure_and_recovery.coordinates: Primary full h/c geometry uses raw coordinates; retain a predeclared fixed h/c block-RMS sensitivity. Never renormalize each evolving or perturbed family to hide contraction. PCA is display only.
closed_structure_and_recovery.numerics: Use native float32 LSTM execution for behavioral interventions and confirm any candidate in float32. Float64 stepping/JVP is diagnostic; compare errors with family radius and intervention size as well as absolute error. Do not copy the old local-return |c|<=updates bound: new snapshots already contain nonzero history.
closed_structure_and_recovery.optional_fixed_observable: scripts/lstm_endogenous_observable_flow.py:observable_probe and scripts/lstm_actor_logit_observable.py:centered_actor_logits supply predefined future-hidden or action-score maps. Keep them explicitly secondary; an observable factor is not automatically a full-state attractor.

cue_repair.minimal_intervention: From the same within-model recurrent and physical state, apply a predefined state edit and compare a correct one-update current-code pulse, ordinary-code pulse, and both directional wrong-PGC pulses. Withdraw the complete current code again after the pulse. Preserve saved goal, RGB, previous action/reward and all nonpredictive entries.
cue_repair.required_adapter_changes: Old select_input uses ordinary current code between pulses; here the between-pulse baseline is ALL current zeros. Never rotate an entire input row unless every non-PGC entry is proven identical. Build wrong pulses by rotating only the native measured travel-direction argument for predictive current slots, not by substituting body heading.
cue_repair.controls: Retain unedited branches under every cue, matched-size radial/random edits, Grid exact shams and post-pulse h/c erasure. Report absolute phase error, coverage, off-curve error and cue-by-state-edit interaction; a collapsed family cannot count as repair.
cue_repair.interpretation: A pulse changes state, not recurrent weights or the subsequent fixed transition law. Phase correction, transverse attraction and later navigation improvement are separate outcomes.

behavioral_causality.adaptation: Add a narrowly timed incoming-h/c and current-code patch to the native evaluator or a native snapshot fork. Preserve the recipient environment, motor state, goal snapshot, clock, PA/PR and coupled random streams. Keep the learned actor in control. Do not reuse the old local-return physical collector, forced movement, planner or success thresholds.
behavioral_causality.validation: An observer-only hook/fork must reproduce the original actions, rewards and states exactly. Real interventions may change later trajectories and reward-triggered visibility; retain actual exposure, event counts, failures and native score.
behavioral_causality.claim: Useful angular-memory causality requires direction-specific state/cue effects on actual navigation. Broad h/c-reset costs alone establish only dependence on recurrent history.

existing_threshold_sources_not_new_freez.task_duration_reference: scripts/lstm_continued_heading_memory.py:geometry_gates and analyze_branch use a2s reference plus2s future assay, full512 states, raw/RMS metrics, and fixed phase/arc sampling. This fits the upper4s training blackout but is still a neural-input intervention.
existing_threshold_sources_not_new_freez.warning: These are existing candidate-screen settings, not universal ring definitions or a newly frozen protocol. lstm_heading_curve_flow.candidate_screen uses much longer30s/5s horizons and must not be silently treated as in-distribution for the new2–4s blackout task.
freeze_before_final_outcomes: context bank and physical-only eligibility rules
native-trace episode split and number of contexts/phases

validated_controls_to_reuse.adapter: scripts/published_ssm_ring_report.py feeds the published full256-neuron learned ring through the same lstm_heading_curve_flow.invariance_probe; its archived comparison passes all8 geometric criteria and a shrinking plane fails invariance/relative recovery.
unit_tests: tests/test_lstm_heading_curve_flow.py: rotating ring, shrinking plane, folded line, collapsed point, full-state off-plane distance
tests/test_lstm_endogenous_curve_recovery.py: exact LSTM JVP, sheared-ring phase/normal separation, expanding normal direction
validated_controls_to_reuse.scope: Existing validation evidence was read; no positive-control training or new benchmark execution was performed for this scaffold.

interpretation_limits: Ring structure can exist without a predictive advantage; preserve separate outcomes.
A negative controlled-family assay does not prove that every possible useful memory representation is absent.
Comparisons across trained networks retain their own hidden coordinates and native goal/CNN backgrounds; do not swap weight blocks or hidden vectors between unaligned networks.
All16 fixed models remain in reports. Contexts, phases and episodes are nested measurements; training seed is the independent unit.
